input.question: What is "clean" about "clean coal"
input.ground_truth: It's not "clean". It's slightly *cleaner* than older styles of coal but that's not hard because coal is the absolute dirtiest source of fuel that we regularly use. "Clean coal" is just a name put on the technology for a 20% cleaner system to make it sound more acceptable to the public. It's a lie.

Okay! Imagine you have a big pile of dirty, black coal. When you burn regular coal, it makes a lot of smoke and dirty stuff that goes into the air. This dirty stuff can make the air unhealthy to breathe and can hurt the Earth.

Now, "clean coal" is when people try to make the coal burn in a way that makes much less smoke and dirty stuff. They use special machines and ways of burning the coal so that most of the bad things stay on the ground and don't go up into the air.

But, even though it's called "clean," it's not *completely* clean. It just tries to be a *little* better than regular coal.
